titleEn: Find Latest Group of Size M
title: 查找大小为 M 的最新分组
summary: 长度 n 的二进制串初始全零，按 arr 每步置一，返回最后仍存在长度恰为 m 的连续一段的步骤编号。
insight: 用 boundary length 技巧维护每个连续一段两端的长度。加入位置时合并左右段，并按被合并/新段是否长度 m 更新当前 m 段数量。
pitfalls: 合并会同时消灭左右两个旧分组
只需在新区间两端写长度

solutions.title: 边界长度合并
solutions.idea: 常数时间更新新置一位置所属连续段长度。
steps: step 处 position=arr[step-1]，left=length[position-1],right=length[position+1]；旧段等于 m 时 groups--
merged=left+1+right，写到 position-left 与 position+right；若 merged==m groups++；groups>0 时 answer=step

code.java: class Solution { public int findLatestStep(int[] arr,int m){int[] length=new int[arr.length+2];int groups=0,answer=-1;for(int step=1;step<=arr.length;step++){int position=arr[step-1],left=length[position-1],right=length[position+1];if(left==m)groups--;if(right==m)groups--;int merged=left+right+1;length[position-left]=length[position+right]=merged;if(merged==m)groups++;if(groups>0)answer=step;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findLatestStep(arr:IntArray,m:Int):Int{val length=IntArray(arr.size+2);var groups=0;var answer=-1;for(step in 1..arr.size){val position=arr[step-1];val left=length[position-1];val right=length[position+1];if(left==m)groups--;if(right==m)groups--;val merged=left+right+1;length[position-left]=merged;length[position+right]=merged;if(merged==m)groups++;if(groups>0)answer=step};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int findLatestStep(vector<int>& arr,int m){vector<int> length(arr.size()+2);int groups=0,answer=-1;for(int step=1;step<=(int)arr.size();++step){int position=arr[step-1],left=length[position-1],right=length[position+1];if(left==m)--groups;if(right==m)--groups;int merged=left+right+1;length[position-left]=length[position+right]=merged;if(merged==m)++groups;if(groups)answer=step;}return answer;} };
